items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: His name was Babbins. His name was -- I'm trying to remember his first name, but his last name was Babbins.

ctx.x: Reel one ran out right in the middle of that story, so you were talking about Joe Wynn, who came to the rescue of the schoolteacher. What was the schoolteacher's name?
His name was Babbins. His name was -- I'm trying to remember his first name, but his last name was Babbins. He was a nephew to Tony Babbins, who became the manager of the Imperial Orchestra.
I see. And so Joe Wynn came to his rescue.
